methods.name: Binary segmentation changepoints (mean, variance, mean and variance; MBIC and manual penalties; Q)
methods.reference: changepoint::cpt.mean, cpt.var, cpt.meanvar (method = 'BinSeg', penalty = 'MBIC' | 'Manual', Q, minseglen = 2)
quantities: total cost (sum of segment costs incl. MBIC terms)
methods.tolerance: changepoints exact; penalty and cost Tol::stat(n) (n = 300, 240)

deviations.quantity: candidate range of a segment's split
deviations.note: p2a searches s + minseglen <= t <= e - minseglen; changepoint's C code narrows that range by one at irregular places (always at the left end, at the right end only for the last segment at minseglen 2), so the two can select different positions on a series with a near-tie at a range edge (87 of 90 random series agreed at minseglen 2); every pinned series is one on which both agree (the case checks it)
